question: Will United Russia (ER) gain the most seats in the next Russian parliamentary election?
resolution_criteria:
Parliamentary elections are to be scheduled to be held in Russia in September 2026.

This market will resolve according to the political party that gains the greatest number of seats in the next Russian State Duma election, compared to before the election.

If the results are not known definitively by September 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

In the event of a tie between multiple parties for the most seats gained, this market will resolve in favor of the party that received a greater number of valid votes. In the event that results in a tie, this market will resolve in favor of the party whose listed abbreviation appears first in alphabetical order.

This market's resolution will be based solely on the number of seats gained by the named party in the State Duma of the Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation.

This market will resolve based on the results of this election, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results reported by Russian government sources such as the Central Election Commission of the Russian Federation.

# Research report 1 of 2

I couldn't find any news dated from 2026-09-01 to 09-11 (step 3), and every page fetch failed ("proxy refused the connection"), so everything below comes from search-result summaries. Many results were dated after 2026-09-11, and I left them out as instructed.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on consensus reporting, with Russia's Central Election Commission (CEC) as the fallback. The criteria give no URL. I could not open the CEC site (izbirkom.ru), so I have no status reading from it.
- **Critical wording:** the question is about seats **gained compared to before the election**, not total seats. United Russia (ER) resolves Yes only if its seat increase beats every other party's. If ER loses seats, a party that gains seats would win.
- **Baseline is unclear:** ER won 324 seats in 2021. A Polymarket research summary and the Wikipedia lead put ER at about 310 sitting seats before the vote, with roughly 14 vacancies. The same source gives LDPR 22 and New People 15 before the vote, while Wikipedia's infobox shows the 2021 figures (21 and 13). If the market counts from 2021 results instead of sitting seats, ER's gain shrinks by about 14. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Russian_legislative_election), [futuresearch](https://futuresearch.ai/app/p/a/among-these-three-russian-parties-only-united)

## 2. Current status
- 2026-09-11: Nothing settles the question yet. Voting runs September 18-20, 2026, and 225 seats are elected by party list and 225 in single-member districts. [Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/07/02/russia-is-gearing-up-for-nationwide-elections-this-is-what-you-need-to-know-a93142)
- The five parties already in the Duma were automatically eligible to run, and 17 parties in total could take part. Yabloko, which campaigned against the war, was reportedly removed from the ballot. [intellinews](https://www.intellinews.com/kremlin-lowers-duma-election-turnout-vote-targets-456332/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- Early August 2026 (exact date unclear): VTsIOM put ER's rating at about 32%. [Gazeta.ru](https://www.gazeta.ru/politics/23376769/vybory-2026-rejtingi-prognozy.shtml)
- July 2026: the Kremlin reportedly lowered its targets of 50% turnout and 55% for ER, which were set in February. State TV gave the campaign little coverage. [intellinews](https://www.intellinews.com/kremlin-lowers-duma-election-turnout-vote-targets-456332/)
- 2026-06-23: Novaya Gazeta Europe, citing Vedomosti, reported lower targets as ER's ratings fell. Regions were still told ER must get more than 300 seats with turnout around 50%. [Novaya Gazeta Europe](https://novayagazeta.eu/articles/2026/06/23/moskva-snizila-tseli-edinoi-rossii-na-vyborakh-v-gosdumu-eto-proizoshlo-na-fone-padeniia-reitingov-partii-news)
- April 2026: VTsIOM survey of 13-19 April had ER at 27.7%. [Yabloko analysis](https://www.yabloko.ru/cat-news/2026/03/30)
- 2026-03-27: VTsIOM had ER at 31%, with LDPR and New People at about 10% each. [Pravda Severa](https://pravdasevera.ru/2026/03/27/69c4fd6fc111029fba05f02c.html)
- 2025-10-28: the Moscow Times reported a Kremlin "55 on 55" target (55% turnout and 55% for ER). [MT Russian](https://ru.themoscowtimes.com/2025/10/28/kreml-zadumal-narisovat-edinoi-rossii-ne-menee-55-golosov-na-predstoyaschih-viborah-v-gosdumu-a178469)
- AI model forecasts reported by Lenta.ru gave ER 48-55% of the vote. [Amic](https://www.amic.ru/news/neyroseti-sprognozirovali-itogi-vyborov-v-gosdumu2026-592158)

## 4. Base rates
These are ER's seat changes from one election result to the next, from memory of standard results tables. Please verify them.
- 2007: 315 seats, about +92 versus 2003. ER gained the most.
- 2011: 238 seats, about -77. Other parties gained, with the Communists (KPRF) and A Just Russia (SR) gaining the most.
- 2016: 343 seats, about +105. ER gained the most.
- 2021: 324 seats, -19. KPRF gained the most (42 to 57), and New People entered with 13.
- So ER was the top gainer in 2 of the last 4 elections. It gains when it raises its share of the 225 district seats, where it usually wins about 85-90%. Measured against roughly 310 sitting seats, simply repeating 2021 would mean about +14. Smaller parties have mostly gained single-digit seat numbers.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket, "ER *gains* the most seats": about 66%, down from about 80% over 30 days before levelling off. Snapshots are dated roughly April-August 2026, and I found no September price. [simplefunctions](https://simplefunctions.dev/markets/0x502a94e5c525766d5ee7f16c6568131ba1b2cbadb69c703af05a6ef00336ed64), [Octagon](https://www.octagonai.co/markets/politics/politics/which-party-will-gain-most-seats-in-russian-parliamentary-election/)
- In the same multi-outcome market, one snapshot had New People at about 35%, LDPR about 5%, and KPRF and SR about 3% each. [lines.com](https://www.lines.com/prediction-markets/elections/which-party-will-gain-most-seats-in-russian-parliamentary-election)
- A separate Polymarket market, "ER *wins* the most seats" (total seats), traded at about 94-98%. [simplefunctions](https://simplefunctions.dev/markets/0x94ffc785f73c9d70c0c9550b2412842d025d20d02f9e9e20a18cc4598944cbc5)
- I found no expert forecast of seat numbers, only the reported Kremlin goal of more than 300 seats.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-09-18 to 09-20: voting, including multi-day and remote electronic voting.
- About a week after the vote: the CEC approves final results. Afterwards, the CEC hands seats declined by winners to the next candidates on each party's list, which can shift the final numbers.
- **Key uncertainties:** how ER does in the single-member districts, whether its party-list share comes in above the roughly 50% it got in 2021 (pre-election polls showed about 28-32%, but those have historically understated ER's official results), and which seat baseline the market uses.

Sources: [Wikipedia 2026 election](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Russian_legislative_election), [Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/07/02/russia-is-gearing-up-for-nationwide-elections-this-is-what-you-need-to-know-a93142), [intellinews](https://www.intellinews.com/kremlin-lowers-duma-election-turnout-vote-targets-456332/), [Novaya Gazeta Europe](https://novayagazeta.eu/articles/2026/06/23/moskva-snizila-tseli-edinoi-rossii-na-vyborakh-v-gosdumu-eto-proizoshlo-na-fone-padeniia-reitingov-partii-news), [Gazeta.ru](https://www.gazeta.ru/politics/23376769/vybory-2026-rejtingi-prognozy.shtml), [Pravda Severa](https://pravdasevera.ru/2026/03/27/69c4fd6fc111029fba05f02c.html), [Yabloko](https://www.yabloko.ru/cat-news/2026/03/30), [Amic](https://www.amic.ru/news/neyroseti-sprognozirovali-itogi-vyborov-v-gosdumu2026-592158), [MT Russian](https://ru.themoscowtimes.com/2025/10/28/kreml-zadumal-narisovat-edinoi-rossii-ne-menee-55-golosov-na-predstoyaschih-viborah-v-gosdumu-a178469), [simplefunctions](https://simplefunctions.dev/markets/0x502a94e5c525766d5ee7f16c6568131ba1b2cbadb69c703af05a6ef00336ed64), [Octagon](https://www.octagonai.co/markets/politics/politics/which-party-will-gain-most-seats-in-russian-parliamentary-election/), [lines.com](https://www.lines.com/prediction-markets/elections/which-party-will-gain-most-seats-in-russian-parliamentary-election), [futuresearch](https://futuresearch.ai/app/p/a/among-these-three-russian-parties-only-united)

# Research report 2 of 2 (written independently)

I couldn't find anything published by 2026-09-11 that settles this. It turns mostly on how "gain the most seats" is read. If it means the most seats won, United Russia (UR) is the overwhelming favourite. If it means the biggest net increase over seats held before the election, it depends on UR's change from its pre-election total, and I could not confirm that total.

## 1. Resolution source
- The criteria give no URL. Results come from "a consensus of credible reporting", or failing that, official results from the Central Election Commission (CEC) at cikrf.ru. I did not reach the CEC site.
- The wording conflicts. The title says "gain the most seats", but the rules count "seats gained… compared to before the election". Some mirrors list the market as "Will United Russia (ER) win the most seats", while octagonai's address uses "gain". [simplefunctions mirror](https://simplefunctions.dev/markets/0x94ffc785f73c9d70c0c9550b2412842d025d20d02f9e9e20a18cc4598944cbc5), [octagonai](https://www.octagonai.co/markets/politics/politics/which-party-will-gain-most-seats-in-russian-parliamentary-election/)
- Baseline: UR won 324 of 450 seats in 2021. A Polymarket mirror says it held 324 going into the vote. I could not check the faction's actual size at dissolution on the Duma website, and vacancies or defections may have changed it. [2021 election](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2021_Russian_legislative_election), [mirror](https://simplefunctions.dev/markets/0x8e41c5c2c887553ea7cce7f3644b50c62c8ab55238b50e939048f6d71aae6d4c)

## 2. Current status

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-11: VCIOM's weekly release puts approval of Putin at 67.4% and trust in him at 73.1%. [VCIOM](https://wciom.ru/analytical-reviews/analiticheskii-obzor/reitingi-prezidenta-pravitelstva-i-politicheskikh-partii-11092026)
- 2026-09-04: VCIOM, week of 24 to 30 August, as summarised by search. I could not open the page myself:
  - UR 37.2%
  - KPRF (Communists) 11.6%
  - New People 11.5%
  - LDPR 8.7%
  - A Just Russia 5.3%

  [VCIOM](https://wciom.ru/analytical-reviews/analiticheskii-obzor/reitingi-prezidenta-pravitelstva-i-politicheskikh-partii-04092026)
- Around 2026-09-04: FOM, the other main pollster, has LDPR at about 11% and KPRF at about 9%. Its New People figure is roughly a third of VCIOM's. [rusmonitor](https://rusmonitor.com/vcziom-i-fom-razoshlis-v-partijnyh-rejtingah.html)
- July 2026: Kommersant reported UR's rating falling to about 33% (FOM) and 32.7% (VCIOM) for the week of 13 to 19 July. [Kommersant](https://www.kommersant.ru/doc/8843878)
- Pre-election: UR official Igor Yakushev said the party expects "at least the same number of mandates" it has now. Experts expected it to keep a two-thirds constitutional majority (over 300 seats). [gazeta.ru](https://www.gazeta.ru/politics/23411845/vybory-v-gosdumu-2026-partii-i-programmy.shtml)
- Analysis of how New People, LDPR and A Just Russia are preparing for the vote. [Riddle](https://ridl.io/how-russia-s-parliamentary-parties-are-preparing-for-the-2026-state-duma-elections-new-people-ldpr-and-a-just-russia/)

## 4. Base rates
- **Most seats won:** UR has won the most seats in every Duma election since 2003, five out of five:
  - 2003: about 223
  - 2007: 315
  - 2011: 238
  - 2016: 343
  - 2021: 324
- **Largest net gain**, using approximate counts from memory, not checked against sources:
  - 2007: UR (+92). Over 2003 to 2021, UR had the largest net gain in about 3 of 5 elections.
  - 2011: KPRF (+35) and A Just Russia (+26). UR fell by 77.
  - 2016: UR (+105).
  - 2021: KPRF (+15) and New People (+13, new entrant). UR fell by 19.
- **Pattern:** UR's net change has swung by about ±20 to 100 seats per election. Single-member districts (225 seats) usually go overwhelmingly to UR, which cushions its total. When UR's poll share falls, opposition parties tend to pick up seats while UR loses some.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket's "Will United Russia (ER) win the most seats" was about 95¢ (95%) with roughly $47M open interest, in a snapshot from around April 2026. Another mirror showed 64% with zero volume. I found no price close to 2026-09-11. [simplefunctions](https://simplefunctions.dev/markets/0x94ffc785f73c9d70c0c9550b2412842d025d20d02f9e9e20a18cc4598944cbc5), [octagonai](https://www.octagonai.co/markets/politics/politics/which-party-will-gain-most-seats-in-russian-parliamentary-election/)
- Polymarket's UR seat-count brackets, from snapshots around April to May 2026:
  - 355 or more seats: 27%
  - 310 to 324 seats: 11%

  There were also 325 to 339 and 340 to 354 brackets, but I couldn't get their prices. Fetches to these mirrors failed, so I couldn't see current prices. [355+](https://simplefunctions.dev/markets/0x2421eb7f6db120f7fa8a4bac72805d412a397b3d99bcb1202a05cf9b35f63176), [310-324](https://simplefunctions.dev/markets/0x8e41c5c2c887553ea7cce7f3644b50c62c8ab55238b50e939048f6d71aae6d4c), [340-354](https://simplefunctions.dev/markets/0x5ee38949a4ba69f716052e5139b03953e2ecf79e8130d583f92acd87e3c1ca68)
- The bracket prices suggest the market expected UR to stay near or above its 2021 total of 324. On a net-gain reading, that matters.
- I found no Kalshi or Manifold market and no formal expert seat projections.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Within about a week of the vote: the CEC certifies the final party-list and single-member district results and distributes the seats.
- A last VCIOM/FOM poll release, around 2026-09-11 to 18, may come out before the vote.
- To watch: UR's party-list share against its 49.8% in 2021, and how many of the 225 single-member districts it wins against 198 in 2021. Together these set UR's seat change from about 324.
